head: d6716ba5
summary: R02 owner journey is implemented and now verified natively end to end. One click on an icon-only Spaces rail entry opens a conversation scoped to that Space directly, mounted inside the authored space-app-content region so the rail stays visible, with the authored contextual chat/history sidebar beside it (selected Space name, one New chat action, that Space's own conversations). This pass added: (a) the selected Space's contextual sidebar with real New chat / open-conversation identities; (b) a real-app thread-affinity fix - the sidebar commands used ConfigureAwait(false) so the chat factory's VerifyAccess threw CUIA_FAILED and the faulted action then blocked an ordinary close; (c) UpdateAddress now honours the published Builder route, fixing a genuine defect where a later state change rewrote the tab address to the selected-Space form while the canonical Space editor was presented; (d) the Browse-host route lane aligned with the canonical surfaces. Native tab roundtrip proven: with a Study Space conversation 576fce50-140f-43b9-bdcf-d42399845e4 and a typed composer draft, a second tab was opened and navigated to https://example.com/, and returning to the Spaces tab restored the same conversation address, the same unsent draft, the rail and the sidebar; the two-tab window then closed normally in 3s. Honest negative finding recorded: in the SAME tab, after navigating to a website the Go back control was disabled (atspi_error: Element not enabled), and re-typing 9to1://spaces produced a fresh Spaces Home rather than restoring the previous conversation - recorded as an open Haven browser-history question entangled with the unavailable Gecko engine, not as a pass. Lane state: HavenOS.Browse.Host.Tests 254 passed / 3 failed (the 3 are the explicit platform guard 'This owning host fixture requires actual Windows Home; Linux is unvalidated'), down from 12 failures at HEAD 3525b860; HavenOS.Spaces.Tests 218/218; CakeOS.Cui.Runtime.Tests 405/405; canonical CUI compilation 13/13; HavenOS.Apps.Browse.Tests 150/150. Still open for R02: native sidebar row click (fresh conversations share the default title 'New chat' so the AT-SPI name is ambiguous; identity is proven headlessly), the in-tab back/forward form, and the generic Launcher New Tab -> Apps -> app same-tab journey for apps other than Spaces.
next_action: Give new conversations distinct default titles so the native sidebar row journey is drivable and run it; then start the Automations scheduling/persistence/execution backend slice (owner priority 3) as bounded commits, and refresh the acceptance handoff for R01/R02/R03/R04.
